data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2 (cycle 2 plan review feedback): If delete_issue rollback exhausts RETRY_BUDGET, the resulting exception is RE-RAISED (not swallowed). Add AC: structured log entry emitted with both original create error and rollback error (use logging.exception or equivalent). Add fault-injection test test_outbound_create_rollback_exhaustion_reraises: Given client.create_issue raises + client.delete_issue raises (exhausts retries); When _outbound_create invoked; Then both exceptions logged AND the rollback exception re-raised (not the original create exception, since rollback failure is the failure mode that needs visibility).
